user.title: Connect a Yakka group
user.description: Open your group in Yakka and copy its link from the address bar. Then create an API token on the group's **Integrations** page.

data_description.token: Starts with yk_. It's shown once when you create it.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for {group}
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {group} was revoked or no longer works. Create a new one on the group's **Integrations** page.

reconfigure.title: Update the Yakka group
reconfigure.description: Use this if the group moved to a different address, or to swap the API token.

error.invalid_link: That doesn't look like a Yakka group link. It should contain /groups/ followed by the group id.
error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid or has been revoked.
error.group_mismatch: This API token belongs to a different group.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Yakka at that address.
error.not_yakka: The server answered, but not like Yakka does. Check the link.

abort.already_configured: This group is already set up.

data.match_users: Match Home Assistant users to members
data.link_users: Choose a member for each Home Assistant user

data_description.default_member: Who chores ticked off from Home Assistant are recorded as. "Automation" records them without a member.
data_description.match_users: When a Home Assistant user ticks a chore off and their name matches a Yakka member, record it as that member instead. Users you link to a member below always use that member.
data_description.link_users: Pick which Yakka member each Home Assistant user records completions as. Turning this off removes the links.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Yakka for changes.
data_description.enable_webhook: Get instant updates and a yakka_event for every completion, undo, due and overdue chore.

users.title: Home Assistant users
users.description: Choose who each Home Assistant user's completions are recorded as. **Match by name** uses the member with the same name, if "Match Home Assistant users to members" is on. **Record as the default** always uses the default member. If a linked member is archived, matching by name is used instead.

webhook.title: Yakka webhook
webhook.description:
On the group's **Integrations** page in Yakka, add an outbound webhook with this URL and choose the events you want:

`{webhook_url}`

Then paste its signing secret below. Yakka must be able to reach this address: use your external URL if you use the public Yakka instance.

auth_failed.message: Yakka rejected the API token. Re-authenticate the integration.

chore_ambiguous.message: Several chores have that title. Use the chore's id or one of its entities.

nothing_to_undo.message: This chore has no completion to undo.

entry_required.message: Several Yakka groups are set up. Choose one with config_entry_id.

complete_chore.name: Complete chore
complete_chore.description: Marks a chore as done in Yakka.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The chore's title, its Yakka id, or the entity id of any of its entities.

member.name: Member
member.description: Who did it: a member name or id. Defaults to the matching Home Assistant user, then the default member from the options, then "Automation".

completed_at.name: Completed at
completed_at.description: When it was done. May be up to 14 days ago. Defaults to now.

config_entry_id.name: Group
config_entry_id.description: Which Yakka group. Only needed when several are set up.

undo_completion.name: Undo completion
undo_completion.description: Undoes a completion in Yakka: a chore's latest one, or a specific one.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: Undo this chore's latest completion. The chore's title, its Yakka id, or the entity id of any of its entities.

completion_id.name: Completion id
completion_id.description: Or undo this completion, e.g. from the Last completed sensor's attributes or a complete_chore response.

config_entry_id.name: Group
config_entry_id.description: Which Yakka group. Only needed when several are set up.
